Description: Synthetic tax records (one per person): salary, tax rate and exemptions by US state.

  single_exemp: state tax exemption for single filers, US dollars; numeric, min 0, median 0, max 12750, share of zeros 63.1%; missing 0.0%

  child_exemp: state tax exemption per child, US dollars; numeric, min 0, median 0, max 3300, share of zeros 62.9%; missing 0.0%
  gender: F or M; text, 2 distinct values; most common: F (50.7%), M (49.2%); missing 0.0%
